gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a gross prior year strengthening of GBP 27.071 million in 2016, representing 14.18% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by a significant increase in incurred claims, particularly on the 2013 and prior years of account, affecting professional indemnity, Directors and Officers, and medical malpractice classes of business. A review by the new Managing Agent and independent claims consultants led to a material strengthening of reserves, including the addition of a large loss load and increases in case reserves. The development was also influenced by late reporting on personal accident claims and the materialisation of large losses, particularly in the directors and officers account for the 2014 year of account, alongside the inherent uncertainty and complex litigation associated with many claims.
